releaseNotes: Fixes the missing live request seen in the v77 two-PC test. Add/RemoveItem now queues the exact operation and samples BP_Cargo.StorageItems on the next controller tick, after Breathedge finishes the transfer. The host then applies the authoritative operation and refreshes the matching open W_InventoryGrid from the native acknowledgement. Update both PCs only after closing Breathedge and repeat the single-Wire open-locker test.
